# Benchmark suites handed to CodSpeed, shared by both workflows:
#   tests.yml           runs these with -m benchmark_high_impact on every PR
#   full-benchmarks.yml runs all benchmarks in these directories, weekly
#
# This is deliberately a subset, NOT every directory matching
# tests/src/core_pdf/impl/engine/**/benchmarks. Three suites that exist on disk
# are absent here: s_07_content, s_07_document and s_07_objects. Do not replace
# this list with a glob -- that silently widens what CI measures, and CodSpeed
# comparisons are only meaningful against a stable benchmark set.
tests/src/core_pdf/impl/engine/render/benchmarks
tests/src/core_pdf/impl/engine/spec/s_07_filters/benchmarks
tests/src/core_pdf/impl/engine/spec/s_07_syntax/benchmarks
tests/src/core_pdf/impl/engine/spec/s_07_security/benchmarks
tests/src/core_pdf/impl/engine/spec/s_08_graphics/benchmarks
tests/src/core_pdf/impl/engine/spec/s_09_fonts/benchmarks
